expected.name: Charles Doyle
expected.description: Charles A. Doyle was a Scottish-born former international vice president of the CIO Gas, Coke and Chemical Workers Union. Immigration authorities arrested him for deportation on February 20, 1948 and held him without bail at Ellis Island. Doyle joined a hunger strike beginning March 1 and was released on bail on March 6. Authorities detained him again at Ellis Island during renewed deportation proceedings in 1952 and 1953; the reviewed records do not provide exact endpoints for that later confinement. He was eventually deported to Britain and died in London in 1983.

operations.research_note: Identified archival newspaper portrait reproduced by Steve Cichon, a Doyle relative. Exact rectangular crop of the portrait portion; retained Buffalo Stories watermark and original pixels. Corroborated against the explicitly captioned 1938 Buffalo Courier-Express photograph identifying Doyle at right. No guessed custody dates added.
